#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an ICS calendar entry for the project kickoff meeting next Monday."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time
import uuid

# --- Determine local timezone and next Monday ---
local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
tz_name = local_tz.key if hasattr(local_tz, "key") else str(local_tz)
today = datetime.now().date()

days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # "next Monday" = one week out if today is Monday
next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

start_local = datetime.combine(next_monday, time(10, 0), tzinfo=local_tz)
end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=2)

fmt = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"
dtstart = start_local.strftime(fmt)
dtend = end_local.strftime(fmt)
dtstamp = datetime.now().astimezone().strftime(fmt)

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff"

ics_content = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}
DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{dtstart}
DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{dtend}
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting to launch the project - agenda, goals, roles and next steps.
LOCATION:TBD
STATUS:CONFIRMED
TRANSP:OPAQUE
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("project_kickoff.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics_content)

# --- Validate: basic parse checks ---
lines = [l for l in ics_content.splitlines() if l.strip()]
assert lines[0] == "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" and lines[-1] == "END:VCALENDAR"
assert any(l.startswith("DTSTART") for l in lines)
assert any(l.startswith("DTEND") for l in lines)
assert any(l.startswith("UID:") for l in lines)
assert any(l.startswith("DTSTAMP:") for l in lines)

print("Created project_kickoff.ics")
print(f"  Event : Project Kickoff Meeting")
print(f"  Start : {start_local.strftime('%A, %Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p %Z')}")
print(f"  End   : {end_local.strftime('%A, %Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p %Z')}")
print(f"  TZ    : {tz_name}")
print(f"  UID   : {uid}")
